findings.current: These mulberry trees had been planted by Zhuge Feng’s descendants, who laid the foundation for the Zhuge Clan as it stood today.
findings.defect: Attributes the planting to Zhuge Feng’s descendants rather than Zhuge Wuhou’s.
findings.rationale: The antecedent of 그의 is the ancient ancestor Zhuge Wuhou, whose supposed planting of the trees Zhuge Feng has just rejected.
findings.replacement: These mulberry trees had been planted by Zhuge Wuhou’s descendants, who laid the foundation for the Zhuge Clan as it stood today.
findings.source: 이 뽕나무들은 현재의 제갈세가의 반석을 다진 그의 후손들이 심은 것이다.

findings.current: “When you return, I hope you’ll have fruit.”
findings.defect: Makes the tree the one that returns, rather than Zhuge Feng.
findings.rationale: Zhuge Feng speaks to the tree immediately before leaving; he hopes to find it bearing fruit upon his return.
findings.replacement: “When I come back, I hope you’ll be bearing fruit.”
findings.source: “다시 돌아올 때는, 열매가 맺혀 있길 바라마.”

findings.current: “This garden is surrounded on all sides, for over a hundred *jang*, by the Family Head’s Hall. Even direct descendants of our family need my permission to enter.”
findings.defect: Changes the garden’s place within the restricted area into a garden surrounded by the hall.
findings.rationale: The Korean places the garden at the center of an area extending some hundred jang, all of which belongs to the Family Head’s Hall.
findings.replacement: “This garden and everything within roughly a hundred *jang* of it are part of the Family Head’s Hall. Even our family’s direct descendants need my permission to enter.”
findings.source: “이 화원을 중심으로 일백여 장이 전부 가주전(家主殿)입니다. 본가의 직계들도 제 허락이 있어야 들어올 수 있지요.”

findings.current: *Wuhou followed Emperor Zhaolie of Han to settle in Bashu. There’s no way the mulberry trees he planted himself could be thousands of *li* away, in Hubei.*
findings.defect: Nested asterisks break the italic formatting of the direct thought.
findings.rationale: The entire passage is a direct thought and should remain italicized.
findings.replacement: *Wuhou followed Emperor Zhaolie of Han to settle in Bashu. There’s no way the mulberry trees he planted himself could be thousands of li away, in Hubei.*
findings.source: ‘무후께서는 한의 소열제(昭烈帝)를 따라 파촉 땅에 자리 잡았거늘, 그분께서 손수 심으셨던 뽕나무가 수천 리 밖의 호북에 있을 리 없지.’

summary: Four actionable fidelity and Markdown defects.
